description: The version history of an app, with a branch per environment: "pre" (every save burst is a commit) and "pro" (each neblla_promote is a merge of pre into it), so this is how an app is rolled back. Without its own repo, Neblla keeps that git for it; linked to its own GitHub repo (neblla_git), the history is that repo's pre and pro branches, read and written with the developer's token, and a restore is a new commit on pre's branch. Actions: "history" (branch?) — the versions, newest first; "files" (commit, branch?) — what one version holds; "restore" (commit, branch?) — put the app's pre back to that version, from either branch (the users get it with neblla_promote). "migrate" (url, toBranch?, toProBranch?) — move the app into a repo of THEIR own WITH its history: pre's branch goes to toBranch (default "main"), pro's to toProBranch (default "neblla-pro"), both must be new in that repo; then the app is linked to it (neblla_git), so from then on pre follows toBranch. restore overwrites pre's files (in their repo, when linked), and migrate writes to their GitHub — only call either when the developer asked for it.

branch.description: For history / files / restore: which environment's branch (default "pre")

commit.description: The version sha, from "history" — required for files/restore

toBranch.description: For "migrate": pre's branch in THEIR repo (default "main")

toProBranch.description: For "migrate": pro's branch in THEIR repo (default "neblla-pro")

url.description: For "migrate": the developer own repo, github.com/owner/repo

name: neblla_versions
